summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, as registrants and depositors for Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 16, 2026, in connection with an issuance of asset-backed notes described in an October 6, 2026 prospectus. The filing satisfies an undertaking to deliver unqualified legality and tax opinions at each takedown, attaching opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP as Exhibits 5.1 and 8.1. No terms, pricing, ratings, or structural changes are disclosed; this is ordinary ABS shelf-takedown administration, not a special situation.
